subtitle: Senior Front-End Developer — React, Next.js, TypeScript
description: MD Hasan Patwary is a Senior Front-End Developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with over 6 years of professional experience building scalable web applications for international markets. He specializes in React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript, with deep expertise in CSS architecture, responsive design, and web performance optimization.

Currently at 6amtech, Hasan has contributed frontend engineering to products including 6valley, 6amMart, StackFood, and Demandium — eCommerce and delivery platforms used by tens of thousands of merchants and customers globally. Before that, 3 years at Themelooks produced 10+ commercial templates on Themeforest and Codecanyon. He writes clean, maintainable code that teams can confidently extend, and is passionate about building interfaces that are fast, accessible, and conversion-optimized.
